source: FJC Integrated Database, Bankruptcy Petition NewSTATS Snapshots (BPNS), FY2008-present
fileFormat: Tab-delimited text with a header row of 87 SAS short names. Text zips: textfiles/cpbank08to17.zip, textfiles/cpbank18on.zip (one row per case per fiscal-year snapshot). datasets/*.zip are SAS .sas7bdat per year.
valueNote: Codebook lists y/n codes in lowercase; the FY2025 text file carries PRFILE as uppercase Y/N and D1FPRSE/JOINT as lowercase y/n. Compare case-insensitively (upper(col)).
note: Variable names and definitions verified against the Feb 2023 codebook. status 'confirmed' = the codebook cites the form, line or petition field; 'inferred' = matched by meaning (e.g. pro se = absence of an attorney).

SNAPSHOT.notOnPetition: FJC statistical bookkeeping, not a petition field.

SNAPFILE.notOnPetition: FJC statistical bookkeeping, not a petition field.

NOB.codes: s Stockbroker, c Commodity Broker, b Clearing Bank, x Railroad, r Single Asset Real Estate, h Health Care Business, n Non-profit Organization, o Other, blank = consumer debt
NOB.caution: The codebook (p.46) says n = Non-profit Organization, o = Other, blank = Consumer Debt, but FY2025 data does not follow it: 62,104 cases carry n, 40,713 of them consumer cases and 61,881 with TAXEXEMPT = N, and no case carries o. In practice n behaves like the petition's 'None of the above' (hub code O). Use TAXEXEMPT for non-profit status. The hub codes also differ (o = Tax Exempt Entity, O = None of the above), so never compare case-insensitively. Before CM/ECF 4.1 (Jan 2011) a trailing t marked tax-exempt (e.g. ht).

codeValues.n: Non-profit Organization per the codebook; in FY2025 data it behaves like 'None of the above' (see caution)

TAXEXEMPT.caution: FY2025 values are uppercase Y/N; compare with lower(). No Official Form field in this IEPD uses BusinessTaxExemptIndicator (tax-exempt status is asked on the non-individual petition, B201).

notCaptured: names, SSNs, addresses (only ZIP and county FIPS are published)
links between a debtor's successive cases (no person identifier is published; PRFILE is only the debtor's yes/no answer to B101 line 9)
caveats: One record per case per snapshot, and snapshots overlap: the Sep 2026 release's rolling 06/30/2026 snapshot repeats 145,740 FY2025 cases from the 09/30/2025 year-end snapshot. The loaders dedupe on CASEKEY, keeping the latest SNAPSHOT (557,540 FY2025 new filings, not 703,280).
Schedule totals are required only for individual debtors with primarily consumer debt and are debtor-reported, not validated.
Debtor-level fields (ZIP, county, pro se) were corrected in Nov 2021 for FY2008-Jun 2021; re-download anything older.
TOTLBLTS treats nulls as zero; TOTDBT treats them as missing, so the two differ.
y/n flags are not consistently cased: in FY2025 PRFILE is Y/N while JOINT and D1FPRSE are y/n. Compare with lower().

The bundled data/sample file is the first 20,000 FY2025 new-filing rows of cpbank18on.txt, not a random sample. Numbers from it are illustrative; load a full year before citing anything. Check count(*) on fjc_bk to see which is loaded.
DISTRICT is an FJC code (73 = California - Central, 3A = Florida - Middle); join table fjc_district for names (codebook Appendix A).

NOB: the FY2025 data does not follow the codebook's NOB labels. 62,104 cases carry n (codebook: Non-profit), 40,713 of them consumer cases, so n behaves like 'None of the above'. Use TAXEXEMPT for non-profit status. Never compare NOB case-insensitively against the hub (hub o = Tax Exempt Entity, O = None of the above).

ORG* variables are the status on the first record submitted (as filed); the unprefixed versions are the most current record. The petition corresponds to ORG*. They differ in under 1% of FY2025 filings except fee status: FEESTS differs from ORGFEESTS in 48.0%.

The FJC data covers every bankruptcy case; this IEPD covers only the individual petition (B101/B105). In FY2025, 12,841 cases are non-individual debtors (DBTRTYP u, p or n; Form B201) and 203 are chapter 9 or 15. For petition-level questions filter dbtrtyp = 'i'.
